capture.contentUnavailable: The previous content was not available to OBEY.
capture.metadataOnly: Only the available identifying metadata was recorded.
capture.auditUnavailable: The audit log could not be checked.
capture.noPermission: Permissions are missing for this log category.

capture.noHistory: There is not enough data to reconstruct that change.
